JobProgress, for jobs that report it) and a final `status`.

Start a stopped runtime (e.g. `colima start`). Follow progress at /api/jobs/{id}/events.

get.description: Server-Sent Events: one `log` event per line, following new output until disconnect.

the app directory (including data/).

the browser; everything else is always an attachment.

Check the link's password and remember it in this browser for a week. A wrong
password is 403, not 401: there's no Athena sign-in involved.

get.description: A folder in a shared folder; paths are relative to the shared folder.

A piece of a file for an upload link, like /api/files/upload. Files go straight
into the shared folder and never replace anything: a taken name gets " (1)".

sign in again).

post.description: Answer the question a create or update returned.

get.description:
A file from the remote, streamed. Folders can't be downloaded: copy them to a
location first. Like the file manager, only images, audio and video show inline.

post.description:
Like /api/files/upload: pieces in order. They're kept on the server, and the file
is sent to the remote after the last one, so that request takes longer.

Copy or move items between a location and a remote, or between remotes, as a
job that reports progress and can be cancelled. Location to location copies use
/api/files/transfer.
What a sync would do: how many files it copies, and which ones it deletes.

that aren't at the source. Run the preview first.

get.description:
Every provider's models, for the model picker. A provider that fails still shows,
with its error, so its model ids can be typed.

post.description:
Server-Sent Events for the reply: `text` and `reasoning` (`delta`, and `new` when a
new block starts), `tool-call` (`id`, `name`, `args`), `tool-result` (`id`, `result`,
`error`), `title`, `usage`, `stopped`, `error` (`message`) and finally `done`.
